info.title: AI Proposal Generator API
info.description: REST API of ai-proposal-generator-api. Obtain a token with POST /api/auth/login, then use 'Authorize'. Workspace-scoped endpoints also need the X-Workspace-Id header.

parameters.name: X-Workspace-Id
parameters.description: Workspace to operate on; the caller must be a member (otherwise 404)

400.description: Invalid request: validation errors (errors[]), malformed body, missing or invalid parameter/header

403.description: Authenticated but not allowed (e.g. OWNER role required)

404.description: Not found, or not visible in the caller's workspace (existence is not disclosed)
